props.gloss_en: Rabba (Abaye's Master): our mishna [one may put water to bran but not knead] is R' Yosei bar Yehuda's
Rabbi: one puts in the flour and another the water -- the latter is liable
R' Yosei bar Yehuda: he is not liable until he kneads
Rabbi: one may not put water to bran
R' Yosei bar Yehuda: one may put water to bran
the baraita: one may not knead kali
and some say: one may knead [kali]
Rav Chisda: the 'some say' is R' Yosei b. R' Yehuda
and that [permission] is only where he alters [the manner]
Rav Chisda: the alteration is [kneading] little by little
and they agree that one may stir shatit on Shabbat
and drink Egyptian zitom
this [one may not knead] is of a thick [mixture] (assignment of the הא per Steinsaltz)
that [they agree one may stir] is of a thin [mixture] (assignment per Steinsaltz)
and that is only where he alters [the manner]
Rav Yosef: on a weekday one puts the vinegar and then the shatit; on Shabbat the shatit and then the vinegar
Levi son of Rav Huna bar Chiyya found the kneader of his household kneading and feeding his ox; he kicked him
and who is 'your mother's father'? R' Yirmeya bar Abba
Rav (via R' Yirmeya bar Abba): one may knead [for animals]
...but one may not feed [it into the animal's mouth]
...and [a calf] that does not take with its tongue -- one puts it in for it
and that is only where he alters [the manner]
Abaye (via Rav Yeimar bar Shelamya): the alteration is [stirring] warp and woof
Rav Yehuda: he shakes it into a vessel
and who is Ze'eiri's master? R' Chiyya
R' Chiyya (in Ze'eiri's notebook): to knead? -- forbidden
...to empty (lefarek)? -- permitted
Rav Menashya: one before one, two before two -- it is fine
...three before two -- forbidden
Rav Yosef: a kav, and even two kav
Ulla: a kor, and even two kor
and who is Levi's master? Rabbeinu haKadosh
they would knead shatit in Babylonia
Rabbi cried out [against kneading shatit], and no one listened to him
Levi: and he had no power to forbid it, because of R' Yosei b. R' Yehuda
RYBL's notebook: one [born] on Sunday will be a man and not one in him
(entertained) 'not one' means not one [quality] for good
Rav Ashi: I was [born] on Sunday
(entertained) 'not one' means not one [quality] for bad
Rav Ashi: I and Dimi bar Kakuzta were [born] on Sunday; I am a king, and he was head of thieves
rather: either all of him for good or all of him for bad
why? because light and darkness were created on it
one [born] on Monday will be an irascible man
why? because the waters were divided on it
one [born] on Tuesday will be rich and promiscuous
why? because grasses were created on it
one [born] on Wednesday will be wise and bright
why? because the lights were hung on it
one [born] on Thursday will be a doer of kindness
why? because fish and fowl were created on it
one [born] on Friday will be a seeker
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: a seeker of mitzvot
one [born] on Shabbat will die on Shabbat
because the great day of Shabbat was desecrated on his account
Rava bar Rav Sheila: and he will be called a great holy one
the mazal of the day [of birth] determines [a person's nature]
R' Chanina: not the mazal of the day determines, but the mazal of the hour
one [born] in the sun['s hour] will be radiant, eat and drink of his own, his secrets revealed; if he steals he will not succeed
one [born] in Venus will be rich and promiscuous
why? because fire was born in it
one [born] in Mercury will be bright and wise
because it is the sun's scribe
one [born] in the moon will bear illnesses, build and destroy, destroy and build, eat and drink not his own, his secrets hidden; if he steals he will succeed
one [born] in Saturn -- his thoughts will come to nothing
and some say: all that is thought against him comes to nothing
one [born] in Jupiter (tzedek) will be just (tzadkan)
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: and just in mitzvot
one [born] in Mars will be a shedder of blood
Rav Ashi: either a blood-letter, or a thief, or a slaughterer, or a circumciser
Rabba: I was [born] in Mars
R' Chanina: mazal makes wise, mazal makes rich
R' Chanina: and Israel has a mazal
R' Yochanan: Israel has no mazal
R' Yochanan: from where that Israel has no mazal? 'learn not the way of the nations... for the nations are dismayed at them' (Jer 10:2) -- they are dismayed, not Israel
Rav (via Rav Yehuda): from where that Israel has no mazal? 'and He brought him outside' (Gen 15:5)
Abraham: Master of the world, 'one born in my house is my heir' (Gen 15:3)
God: no -- 'rather one that comes forth from your innards' (Gen 15:4)
Abraham: I looked at my astrology, and I am not fit to beget a son
God: go out of your astrology, for Israel has no mazal
God: what is your thought -- that Jupiter stands in the west? I will turn it back and set it in the east
and that is what is written: 'who raised up from the east; tzedek calls him to his feet' (Isa 41:2)
Ablet: this man will go and not come back; a snake will bite him and he will die
Shmuel: if he is a Jew, he will go and come back
while they sat he went and came back; Ablet threw down his load and found in it a snake cut and cast in two pieces
the man: every day we pool bread and eat; today one had none and was ashamed; I said I would collect, and when I reached him I made as if I took from him, so that he would not be ashamed
you have done a mitzva
'and charity saves from death' (Prov 10:2) -- not from an unusual death, but from death itself
the Chaldeans: on the day she enters the wedding canopy a snake will bite her and she will die
that day she took her hairpin and stuck it in the wall; it happened to go into the snake's eye; in the morning, when she took it, the snake came trailing after it
the daughter: in the evening a poor man came and called at the door, and everyone was busy with the meal; I took the portion you gave me and gave it to him
the Chaldeans to his mother: your son will be a thief
his mother: cover your head, so that the fear of Heaven be upon you, and pray for mercy
one day he sat studying under a palm; the cloak fell from his head; he raised his eyes, saw the palm, his inclination overcame him, he climbed and bit off a cluster with his teeth

supports.gloss_en: דתניא בהדיא: רבי יוסי בר יהודה אומר נותנין מים למורסן -- explicitly of bran
ואזדא רבי יוחנן לטעמיה, דאמר רבי יוחנן: מניין שאין מזל לישראל...
ואף רב סבר אין מזל לישראל, דאמר רב יהודה אמר רב: מניין... שנאמר ויוצא אותו החוצה
ומדשמואל נמי אין מזל לישראל -- Ablet's prediction failed; the man returned
ומדרבי עקיבא נמי אין מזל לישראל -- the Chaldeans' prediction for his daughter failed
ומדרב נחמן בר יצחק נמי אין מזל לישראל -- the Chaldeans' 'a thief', his covered head, and the palm

objections.gloss_en: דילמא עד כאן לא קאמר רבי יוסי בר יהודה התם אלא קמח דבר גיבול הוא, אבל מורסן דלאו בר גיבול הוא אפילו רבי יוסי בר יהודה מודה -- perhaps he spoke only of flour, which is kneadable; of bran even he concedes

answered_by.gloss_en: לא סלקא דעתא, דתניא בהדיא: אין נותנין מים למורסן, דברי רבי; רבי יוסי בר יהודה אומר: נותנין מים למורסן

objections.gloss_en: והאמרת אין גובלין! -- but you said one may not knead [so how may one stir shatit]?

answered_by.gloss_en: לא קשיא: הא בעבה, הא ברכה -- one is a thick mixture, the other thin (= p_okimta_ava, p_okimta_raka)

objections.gloss_en: והא לא מערב שפיר? -- but [so] it does not mix well

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר רב יהודה: מנערו לכלי (= p_rav_yehuda_menaaro)

objections.gloss_en: והאמר רב אשי: אנא בחד בשבא הואי -- Rav Ashi was born on Sunday, [and not without good]
והאמר רב אשי: אנא ודימי בר קקוזתא הוינן בחד בשבא, אנא מלך והוא הוה ריש גנבי
אמר רבה: אנא במאדים הואי -- I was [born] in Mars [and am none of these]

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר אביי: מר נמי עניש וקטיל -- the Master too punishes and kills

nodes.label_he: והני מילי הוא דמשני

nodes.label_he: ושוין שבוחשין את השתית בשבת

nodes.label_he: הא ברכה
nodes.label_en: that [they agree one may stir] is of a thin [mixture] (assignment per Steinsaltz)

nodes.label_he: והני מילי הוא דמשני
nodes.label_en: and that is only where he alters [the manner]

nodes.label_en: Levi son of Rav Huna bar Chiyya found the kneader of his household kneading and feeding his ox; he…

nodes.label_he: ומנו -- רבי ירמיה בר אבא
nodes.label_en: and who is 'your mother's father'? R' Yirmeya bar Abba

nodes.label_he: גובלין
nodes.label_en: Rav (via R' Yirmeya bar Abba): one may knead [for animals]

nodes.label_he: ולא מספין
nodes.label_en: ...but one may not feed [it into the animal's mouth]

nodes.label_he: ודלא לקיט בלישניה -- מלקיטין ליה
nodes.label_en: ...and [a calf] that does not take with its tongue -- one puts it in for it

nodes.label_he: והני מילי הוא דמשני
nodes.label_en: and that is only where he alters [the manner]

nodes.label_en: Rabbi cried out [against kneading shatit], and no one listened to him

nodes.label_he: ולית חילא בידיה למיסר מדרבי יוסי ברבי יהודה
nodes.label_en: Levi: and he had no power to forbid it, because of R' Yosei b. R' Yehuda

nodes.label_he: האי מאן דבחד בשבא -- יהי גבר ולא חדא ביה

nodes.label_en: (entertained) 'not one' means not one [quality] for good

nodes.label_he: והאמר רב אשי: אנא בחד בשבא הואי
nodes.label_en: Rav Ashi: I was [born] on Sunday

nodes.label_he: אלא לאו חדא לבישו
nodes.label_en: (entertained) 'not one' means not one [quality] for bad

nodes.label_he: אלא: אי כוליה לטיבו, אי כוליה לבישו
nodes.label_en: rather: either all of him for good or all of him for bad

nodes.label_he: מאי טעמא? דאיברו ביה אור וחושך
nodes.label_en: why? because light and darkness were created on it

nodes.label_he: האי מאן דבתרי בשבא יהי גבר רגזן
nodes.label_en: one [born] on Monday will be an irascible man

nodes.label_he: מאי טעמא? משום דאיפליגו ביה מיא
nodes.label_en: why? because the waters were divided on it

nodes.label_he: האי מאן דבתלתא בשבא -- יהי גבר עתיר וזנאי יהא
nodes.label_en: one [born] on Tuesday will be rich and promiscuous

nodes.label_he: מאי טעמא? משום דאיברו ביה עשבים
nodes.label_en: why? because grasses were created on it

nodes.label_he: האי מאן דבארבעה בשבא -- יהי גבר חכים ונהיר
nodes.label_en: one [born] on Wednesday will be wise and bright

nodes.label_he: מאי טעמא? משום דאיתלו ביה מאורות
nodes.label_en: why? because the lights were hung on it

nodes.label_he: האי מאן דבחמשה בשבא -- יהי גבר גומל חסדים
nodes.label_en: one [born] on Thursday will be a doer of kindness

nodes.label_he: מאי טעמא? משום דאיברו ביה דגים ועופות
nodes.label_en: why? because fish and fowl were created on it

nodes.label_he: האי מאן דבמעלי שבתא -- יהי גבר חזרן
nodes.label_en: one [born] on Friday will be a seeker

nodes.label_he: האי מאן דבשבתא יהי -- בשבתא ימות

nodes.label_he: אמר רבא בר רב שילא: וקדישא רבא יתקרי
